theme: SIP fundamentals: power of compounding, rupee cost averaging
headline: Consistent investing builds wealth over time
body: Small regular investments harness compounding growth. Investing at different price points reduces timing risk through rupee cost averaging.
caption: Compounding amplifies your investments as earnings generate further earnings. Rupee cost averaging smooths out market volatility by investing fixed amounts regularly. #SIPFundamentals #CompoundingPower #RupeeCostAveraging #WealthBuilding #InvestingBasics
